mapper.select: SELECT reject_num rejectNum ,monitor_num monitorNum,c2s_byte_len c2sByteLen,s2c_byte_len s2cByteLen, new_uni_conn_num newUniConnNum,live_conn_num liveConnNum,drop_conn_num dropConnNum,loop_conn_num loopConnNum FROM ntc_total_report where report_time between #{start} and #{end}

SELECT #{end} time,entrance_id area,service type,SUM(sum) count FROM ntc_entrance_report WHERE report_time BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND service in (16,17,18,19,20,21,22,23,24,33,34,35,36,64,65, 256,257,258,259,260,267,261,262,263,264,265,266, 512,513,521,528,544,560,576,26,27,30,31) GROUP BY entrance_id,service;

SELECT #{end} time,entrance_id area, s_ip src_ip, d_ip dst_ip,service type,SUM(sum) count FROM ntc_service_behav_statistic WHERE report_time between #{start} AND #{end} GROUP BY s_ip,d_ip,service,entrance_id
SELECT s_ip src_ip,d_ip dst_ip,service type FROM ntc_service_behav_statistic order by stat_id desc LIMIT 100;

SELECT #{end} time, entrance_id area,sum(sum) count FROM ntc_entrance_report a WHERE a.report_time between #{start} and #{end} AND service in (16,17,18,19,20,21,22,23,24,33,34,35,36,64,65, 256,257,258,259,260,267,261,262,263,264,265,266, 512,513,521,528,544,560,576,26,27,30,31) GROUP BY entrance_id;
SELECT service_id type, count(cfg_type) count FROM ui_cfg_num_statistics WHERE cfg_state = 1 GROUP BY service_id ORDER BY count desc;
